sentences.en: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.
sentences.zh: 洪水把很多房子都冲走了。

sentences.en: The flood was the greatest disaster they had ever had.
sentences.zh: 那场洪水是他们经历过的最大灾难。

sentences.en: The flood did a lot of harm to the crops.
sentences.zh: 洪水对农作物造成了很大的破坏。
